The decision comes from two records. In one, you said "Actually tokio has a better ecosystem". In the other, commit `6db5e34` set `config/decisions/revoke-async-runtime.json` to `"value": "tokio"`.

The Muninn heartbeat reports 20 hook runs that started and never finished, which suggests a hook is exceeding its timeout. It didn't affect this task, but `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` would show which hook.
